topic: The loudest sound in history was heard 5000 kilometres away
hook: The loudest sound in history was heard 5000 kilometres away.
script: The loudest sound in history was heard 5000 kilometres away. When Krakatoa erupted in 1883, the explosion was so powerful it ruptured eardrums 64 kilometres away. The sound wave circled the Earth four times. It was heard in Australia, India and even Rodriguez Island — 5000 kilometres away. Sound travelling that far is physically extraordinary. Follow for facts about the raw power of our planet.
